svg.title: The Study · an evening colour study
svg.desc: Matched eye-level fixed and removable finish impressions from the same current occupied Study. Exact floor faces, wall cassettes, opening geometry and furniture footprints; palettes, glazing bars, moulding impressions and furniture heights are presentation trials. No daylight, electric-light or material performance is simulated.

g.text: The Study · an evening colour study
Current occupied room · the same eye point, windows and furniture in both alternatives
Gravity-hung timber faces · seated oak floor
Bound geometry: 8 walls · 99 wall faces · 144 floor pieces · south window at X2100 mm.
Colours, glazing bars and local moulding impressions are appearance trials. Furniture footprints are bound; heights follow the existing view convention.
Evening palette only: no lamp output, circuit, illuminance or glare result. Owner appearance judgement remains open.
